doc.title: Benny Waters interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 1, 1995

title: Closing remarks
summary: Woods concludes the interview and Waters modestly thanks him.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well, this concludes our interview with the great Benny Waters, one of the most fabulous alto sax players in these United States.
But you live up to it in every way. You live up to it in every way.
Well I thank you so much, but I don’t feel that way myself. I just feel that I play quite well for my age and so forth, and I play quite well, but so many guys play so well, you know.
Thank you, thank you. © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-
